answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can transact, with reputation that rises only through slowly peer-attested honest work. A fresh identity starts at a reputation nadir, so a sybil swarm must fund one bond per fake and then wait out the slow climb. Honest participants form a reef of cross-attestations collusion cannot cheaply imitate; any detected ring is slashed, and a gale of coordinated fakes burns the attacker capital faster than it can earn, making the attack net-negative.
